Discord Voice Mixer FIX
Maintained by FarisSoze. A modified community fork of Discord Volume Mixer.

https://github.com/CZDanol/StreamDeck-DiscordVolumeMixer2

Their source, pinned upstream commits and modifications are documented in the
deps/ folders of the source repository. Original copyright notices are retained.

Qt 6.2.4 runtime libraries are dynamically linked.
